notes.title: New Level
notes.notes:
Level 13 is added:

- It is the hardest level.
- All enemy's types spawned at the start.
- More spawn by time.
- Enemies grow stronger faster by time.

You have a find a good strategy right away to survive the first 100 seconds, then you need to come up with a better strategy if you want to keep surviving.
